name: text-lookup
title: Weekday name lookup
summary: Today's weekday name, picked at run time from a seven-name list with textLookup indexed by weekDay().
prompt: Show today's weekday name ("Wednesday") picked from a list of seven day names.
teaches: Declare a list of strings with addDataList and give it an id
Pick one entry at run time with textLookup(array, index) and keep the result in varName
Index by the date: weekDay() is 1 (Monday) to 7 (Sunday), so weekDay() % 7 indexes a Sunday-first list

snippets.note: addDataList: seven day names, id days
draw the looked-up text id like any other text, centred at componentWidth() / 2

check.describe: At 2026-10-28 (a Wednesday) it reads "Wednesday". Resized (190, 450 wide) the day name stays centred under TODAY.

pitfalls: weekDay() runs 1 (Monday) to 7 (Sunday): index a Sunday-first list with weekDay() % 7, a Monday-first one with weekDay() - 1
addDataList's `id` is a json2rc extension: the Java reference parser discards the list's id, so textLookup cannot name the list there and the document only converts with json2rc
Declare the list and the textLookup before the draw that uses varName: the name only exists from the textLookup on
java_difference: json2rc-only: Java's addDataList drops the list id, so textLookup can't reach it (EXAMPLES_FINDINGS U4)
